ce_bugs.text: app/models/topic_embed.rb:22 — Feed content is persisted as raw HTML without sanitization, so a compromised feed can inject same-origin stored XSS into every embed viewer.
lib/tasks/disqus.thor:114 — Removing the public `--category` option breaks existing import scripts and silently drops callers' category selection.

app/assets/javascripts/embed.js:7 — The embed API concatenates `discourseUrl` without normalizing a trailing slash, so a valid base URL like `https://forum.example.com` produces a broken endpoint URL.
app/models/topic_embed.rb:64 — Root-relative rewriting corrupts scheme-relative URLs such as //cdn.example.com/image.png by treating the CDN hostname as a path on the article host.

app/models/topic_embed.rb:64 — Relative links without a leading slash are never resolved against the article URL, so imported links and images can point at the Discourse host instead of the source page.
db/migrate/20131223171005_create_top_topics.rb:3 — Adding force: true to table creation can drop an existing top_topics table and its data during migration execution.

lib/topic_retriever.rb:41 — Every distinct missing embed URL reruns the entire feed poll, causing an unbounded feed download and per-item database/import work that can amplify concurrent requests into severe load.
app/models/topic_embed.rb:48 — Remote article retrieval has no open/read timeout, so a stalled origin can occupy a Sidekiq worker indefinitely.
app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:35 — One malformed feed item raises while decoding content and prevents all later valid items in the feed from being imported.
app/models/topic_embed.rb:22 — Feed-supplied HTML is stored with raw_html cooking and rendered without sanitization, enabling persistent XSS through malicious RSS content.

app/models/topic_embed.rb:48 — open-uri follows redirects without revalidating the destination host or blocking private addresses, allowing an approved embed host to redirect user-triggered fetches into internal services.

spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:39 — The test still expects synchronous TopicRetriever construction even though the controller now enqueues RetrieveTopic, so this spec will fail and does not verify the queued job payload.

mrv_findings.text: app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:35 — P1 confidence 75 — `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` — Ruby 2.0 lacks `String#scrub`, so every feed import reaching this line raises `NoMethodError`.

app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:34 — P1 confidence 75 — `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` — Valid RSS/Atom items without `content` neither fall back to `description` nor get skipped, so one such entry aborts the entire poll.

app/views/embed/loading.html.erb:7 — P2 confidence 75 — `document.location.reload();` — The loading flow has no terminal failure or timeout state, so a permanently failed retrieval reloads forever without an actionable error.

db/migrate/20131223171005_create_top_topics.rb:3 — P2 confidence 100 — `create_table :top_topics, force: true do |t|` — The embed/feed-import change modifies an unrelated historical migration, creating untraceable scope drift and potentially dropping an existing table.

lib/tasks/disqus.thor:116 — P1 confidence 100 — `method_option :strip, aliases: '-s', required: false, desc: "Text to strip from titles"` — Removing the formerly supported `--category/-c` option silently breaks the importer CLI contract and forces imported topics out of their requested category.

lib/topic_retriever.rb:41 — P1 confidence 75 — `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` — One missing embed synchronously imports the entire feed, making every cache miss an unbounded network/parse/database batch whose failure prevents direct retrieval fallback.

app/models/topic_embed.rb:36 — P1 confidence 75 — `revisor.revise!(user, absolutize_urls(url, contents), skip_validations: true, bypass_rate_limiter: true)` — The post revision and later content-hash update are not transactional or success-checked, so a failed save can still suppress all retries.

db/migrate/20131217174004_create_topic_embeds.rb:4 — P2 confidence 100 — `t.integer :topic_id, null: false` — The unconstrained topic identifier has no foreign key, so deletion or bad writes can leave an embed pointing to a nonexistent topic.

db/migrate/20131217174004_create_topic_embeds.rb:5 — P2 confidence 100 — `t.integer :post_id, null: false` — The unconstrained post identifier has no foreign key, permitting orphaned embeds that break the update path.

app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:35 — P1 confidence 100 — `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` — Untrusted feed HTML is imported with raw HTML rendering and validation bypassed, enabling persistent XSS in the same-origin embed iframe.

app/models/topic_embed.rb:13 — P1 confidence 75 — `contents << "\\n
\\n#{I18n.t('embed.imported_from', link: "#{url}")}\\n"` — An attacker-controlled embed URL is interpolated unescaped into an HTML attribute and body, enabling persistent markup or script injection.

app/models/topic_embed.rb:48 — P1 confidence 75 — `doc = Readability::Document.new(open(url).read,` — Hostname-only validation does not constrain resolved IPs or redirects, allowing DNS rebinding or redirects to reach loopback and private services.

app/assets/javascripts/embed.js:17 — P2 confidence 75 — `if (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1) { return; }` — Substring origin validation accepts attacker origins embedded in the Discourse URL, allowing forged resize messages and iframe UI manipulation.
spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:10 — P2 confidence 100 — `response.should_not be_success` — The test claims a 404 but accepts any failure status, so an unrelated 500 response passes.

spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:43 — P1 confidence 100 — `TopicRetriever.expects(:new).returns(retriever)` — The test asserts synchronous retrieval while the controller enqueues a job, so it tests a nonexistent path and misses the actual job contract.

spec/components/topic_retriever_spec.rb:34 — P1 confidence 75 — `topic_retriever.expects(:retrieved_recently?).returns(false)` — Mocking both the throttle decision and retrieval reduces coverage to choreography, leaving the new Redis throttle, fallback, short circuit, and remote import untested.

spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb:35 — P1 confidence 75 — `poller.expects(:poll_feed).once` — The enabled-path test replaces the substantive feed-fetch/parse/import method with a mock, so broken item handling and imports still pass.
